notes:
Short summary: SilkBranch builds an IDE-integrated copilot for enterprise dev teams. Primary ask = repository-aware retrieval + extremely low first-token latency for streaming completions. Wants a hybrid approach: quick hosted POC then private/VPC for customer repos.

What they told us / call highlights:
- 'We need completions in the editor that feel instantaneous — p50 first token <150ms, p99 <300ms for single-file completions.'
- Strong requirement: repo code and proprietary snippets must never leave customer VPC or on-prem storage in production.
- Interested in model pinning per-customer (pin to open-source code models), and automated fallback to smaller models for cold starts.
- Emphasis on embedding freshness: incremental indexing, near-realtime updates when PRs merge.

Technical desires (dev shorthand):
- repo-aware retrieval: function-level chunking + file-metadata-aware vectors, de-dup by hash, prefer semantic + lexical hybrid search.
- vector DB: evaluating options (self-hosted Milvus vs Pinecone) but wants Redwood-managed vector routing to keep inference close to embeddings.
- chunking: prefer heuristics: 1) split by function/class, 2) keep context window ~4-8KB, 3) preserve imports/typedefs as prefix.
- caching: prefix/KV cache for active files, sticky routing for editors to reduce KV cache misses.
- streaming: user-visible streaming with TLS + low-latency transport (SSE or WebSocket), abort/resume support in editor plugin.

POC scope so far:
- Index ~50k files across three repositories (microservices + frontend).
- 10 internal devs for 4-week trial; measure 1) RT first-byte latency, 2) retrieval relevance on labeled prompts, 3) token cost per session.

Security / compliance thread:
- Completed SOC2 questionnaire initial pass. Security wants KMS integration and audit trail for each vector ingestion + query.
- Must provide SAML metadata + IP allowlist for VPC peering.

Quotes & tone from recent demo:
- SE: 'Relevant snippets must be deterministic — we need consistent recall after model and quantization changes.'
- Eng lead: 'If retrieval is noisy, devs will ignore the copilot.'

CRM style notes / short fragments (useful for AE):
- Demo 2026-02-14 (ff_20260214_3274) — good buy signal on model pinning feature.
- Security call 2026-02-20 — asked for KMS + audit logs pattern; raised Data Residency EU question.
- POC checklist sent (drive://silkbranch/poc-plan-v2).
- Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions: batching + quantization profiles for cost reduction.

Risks / Concerns:
- Legal negotiation on data residency clause (customer contracts) will stretch timeline.
- If private deployment timeline slips, they may evaluate building an on-prem agent instead (higher cost, more ops).

Suggested Redwood playbook notes:
- Offer hybrid: hosted API for initial indexing + evaluation, private (VPC) for production repos.
- Prepackage SAML + template VPC peering docs and a sample KMS integration guide.
- Propose evaluation metrics: first-byte latency (p50/p95/p99), retrieval precision@5 on curated prompt set, monthly cost per active dev.
